title: zsh command history
whyItMatters: zsh is the default shell on modern macOS. Its history file can contain typed commands, paths and sometimes tokens or passwords.
source: macOS shell history forensics: ~/.zsh_history is the default zsh history file (Apple default shell since Catalina)
notes: Only existence, size and timestamps are recorded. Commands are never read. An extended history file under a custom HISTFILE is out of scope.
